fix: src/render/stage.js, streakNode, line ~1946 and lines 1948-1949 -- the same two lines r7 named, which were not touched. Do not add a fourth lobe; DELETE the disc-chord scene lobe's hard rim. (a) `const s = u.mul(u).oneMinus().max(0.0)` forces the profile to zero at |u|=1, so the plateau MUST end in a cliff no matter what exponent is chosen; that clamp is the defect. Replace the whole `s.pow(qc)` family with a kernel that has no finite support -- carry the core as `exp(-|u|/a)` or `1/(1+(u/a)^2)^n` and let `b/R` grow `a`, exactly as r7 asked -- so the same expression produces the cusp AND the tail and there is nothing left for an aperture lobe to paper over. (b) Then remove or heavily reduce `U.fApA`: it exists only to hide the slab, and once the scene lobe is a real PSF a second additive core will push `filament` further below the plates.
